svg.data-weight-note: 23.69 lb (10.75 kg) with two power supplies and five fan modules installed (Table 9)
svg.data-depth-note: 20.48 in (52.02 cm) excluding the fan and power supply handles (Table 9)
svg.data-sfp28-speeds: 25, 10 or 1 GbE, set a quad at a time; the default is 10 GbE (Table 4)
svg.data-qsfp28-speeds: 100 or 40 GbE; channelizes to 4 x 25 or 4 x 10 GbE (Table 4)
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz, 7.8 A at 100 to 120 VAC, 3.8 A at 200 to 240 VAC
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating range -40.8 to -72 VDC, 20 A maximum
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, load-sharing and fully redundant; both should be installed
svg.data-fans: five fan modules, 4+1; the switch runs 30 seconds without thermal shutdown while one is replaced
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 45 C (32 to 113 F) normal operation
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 2000 m (6562 ft)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 4 EX4650 switches, no other model. Two members before Junos OS 20.1R1. Any non-channelized QSFP28 port (48 to 55) can be a virtual chassis port
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25 GbE, 10 GbE or 1 GbE; the guide gives a restriction on 1GbE copper optics other than OEM part FCLF8521P2BTL-J1
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100 GbE or 40 GbE; channelizes to 4 x 25 GbE or 4 x 10 GbE (guide Table 6)
svg.data-oob: two RJ-45 management ports (C0 and C1) with link and status lamps
